title: 第12章 御兽决第13章 妖兽暴乱
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
众人休息了一夜，伤势恢复了七八成。
大家相视一笑，这可是四阶妖兽啊！看着大家平安无事！这头妖兽估计能卖百万金币了
众人再次开始了探险，大概有十里左右有三个洞门，也到了洞底
“走吧！看看都有什么宝贝！”
推开石门，众人惊呆了，满满的箱子堆满了石室，大概有50只箱子，30箱金币，一箱足足5万金币，还有20箱灵石.这是下品灵石，一箱有一千颗.这个落霞郡都超不过5颗灵石.10万金币兑换一块灵石，但是没人用灵石兑换金币的。这里足足2万灵石。
“这些我们平分吧！柳嫣然只拿了两箱灵石，其他人每人三箱灵石，金币5箱，就算去了皇城，每个人的财富都能吊打八大家族了，当然了跟四大宗门和王室还是没法比的”
每个人洋溢的笑容，想藏都藏不住，叶辰确显得平静，是啊，堂堂天帝确实看不上这些东西，不过眼下确实是叶辰最需要的，不过叶辰想要的这些远远不够，慢慢来呗！
打开第二个石室，上百本功法整整齐齐的摆放在书架上，叶辰是不需要，这些朋友需要
“你们先选吧，剩下的归我，如果都想要同一部功法的，一会都可以抄录一下”
叶辰要组建势力，一些功法也不好拿出，这些功法也还是可以先拿来用的，大概五个时辰，基本上都抄录完毕，叶辰将所有的功法全部收了起来，大家也没有丝毫觉得不妥。
来到了第三个石室，只有一坐枯骨，手骨上一枚储物戒，这是中品的储物戒
叶辰打开看了一下，一枚御兽宗的令牌，两枚玉简
“有缘人你好，我本是大韩帝国御兽宗的少宗主杨靖。因家父因病去世，宗内争权夺利，加上其他宗门打压，内忧外患，最终宗内一赵姓长老与七星宗里应外合灭了我御兽宗，望有缘人能得我宗传承，替我宗报仇，重建宗门，将本宗传扬天下”
叶辰看后深深鞠了一躬，读取另一玫玉简《御兽诀》
前世倒是对御兽没有研究，今生竟得到了御兽诀，
“乾坤借法，万妖听令，以吾之志，驱汝之使，以灵画印，以神融之……”
御兽诀竟是以魂入印，神魂驱使，最后加上血契便能让妖兽认主。
叶辰将枯骨安葬，再次鞠了一躬，得你传承，我必为你讨回公道，将你传承发扬光大，千秋万代。只是御兽宗格局太小，就不给你重建了。
“你们每人轮流记一下御兽诀，以后碰到合适的妖兽可以试一试，给自己找一个战斗伙伴”叶辰也没有独吞。
玉鸳鸯满意的笑着“大家出来快一个月了，我们在此调整两日，这次我们出来六人，回去七人，哈哈哈，大家能够团结一致，没有失去一个伙伴，真的万分感谢大家！希望以后可以经常历练，这个月月底玲珑商会有场拍卖会，大家有兴趣参加的，我们月底相聚”

“鸳鸯不要如此见外，以后我们就是生死与共的家人，兄弟姐妹”
大家哈哈大笑，聊了一会天，各自去调息修炼了，这几日的生死搏斗，的确需要好好调理，避免留下隐患
叶辰取出10块灵石摆出简易的聚灵阵，收敛心神，屏气凝神双手掐诀，顷刻之间，灵气集聚过来，越来越浓，介于灵气液化的程度，混沌珠也疯狂的吸收
经过两日的苦修，叶辰进入了极境，也就是淬体境十重天，虽然还没有进入炼气境，但是这时的叶辰气息雄厚，已经可以灵气外放了，炼气境开始就可以修炼法诀，以气御敌，修剑可以用剑气攻击，火灵根的可以修炼灵火诀，以气御火，不再是简简单单的靠武技，丹田灵气的纯厚，灵诀的高低，都是影响战斗力的
炼气境才算真正的开始修仙了，淬体境只是打牢身体根基
叶辰取出备好的衣服，穿戴整齐，头顶玉冠，腰间玉带紧扣，剑眉星目，云龙纹靴，七彩琉璃披风，玉树临风，风流倜傥
柳嫣然此时面红耳赤，小心脏扑通扑通的，羞答答的看着叶辰
“叶辰，你去我家提亲可好，”声音几乎不可见，叶辰温柔的看着“嫣然，我知道你的心意，我们还小，三年以后你还喜欢我，我就娶你，也算给了嫣然一个肯定的回答”
叶辰前世只知修炼，男女之事很少考虑，拒绝了很多仙女。今生不在排斥，毕竟是降维打击，前世修炼的刻苦，今生重走，自然是事半功倍
柳嫣然此时的爱的越深，日后恨得也就越深，情之一字，直教人生死相许，世间安得两全法，不负如来不负卿。
玉鸳鸯本想和叶辰聊聊，虽说仅仅只是喜欢，但也种下了爱情的种子
玉鸳鸯单纯可爱，但也理性，属于那种凡事看淡，万事皆轻的性子
看着柳嫣然在陪着叶辰，倒也没有打扰，也没有一丝的不悦，这也造成了玉鸳鸯爱的最长最苦，世间良药千千万，却无一药治相思
大家都修炼结束了，伤势都调理好了，一群少年少女，鲜衣怒马。
“走吧！回家”玉鸳鸯洋溢着笑容
“回家！”
content_en:
Everyone rested for a night and recovered 70% to 80% of their injuries.
Everyone looked at each other and smiled, this is a fourth-level monster! See everyone is safe and sound! This monster can probably be sold for millions of gold coins.
Everyone started exploring again. There were three cave entrances about ten miles away, and they also reached the bottom of the cave.
"Let's go! See what treasures there are!"
Pushing open the stone door, everyone was shocked. The stone room was filled with boxes. There were about 50 boxes, 30 boxes of gold coins, one box worth 50,000 gold coins, and 20 boxes of spirit stones. These were low-grade spirit stones, with a box containing a thousand. Even Luoxia County could not exceed 5 spirit stones. 100,000 gold coins could be exchanged for one spirit stone, but no one exchanged spirit stones for gold coins. There are 20,000 spirit stones here.
"Let's share these equally! Liu Yanran only took two boxes of spirit stones, and everyone else took three boxes of spirit stones and five boxes of gold coins. Even if they go to the imperial city, everyone's wealth can beat the eight major families. Of course, it is still incomparable with the four major sects and the royal family."
Everyone's overflowing smiles couldn't be hidden even if they wanted to. Ye Chen seemed calm indeed. Yes, the mighty Emperor of Heaven does not despise these things, but right now it is indeed what Ye Chen needs most, but what Ye Chen wants is far from enough. Take your time!
Opening the second stone room, hundreds of exercise books were neatly placed on the bookshelf. Ye Chen didn't need it, these friends needed it.
"You choose first, and the rest belongs to me. If you all want the same technique, you can copy it in a while."
Ye Chen wanted to build a force, and it was difficult to take out some of the exercises. These exercises could still be used first. In about five hours, they were basically copied. Ye Chen put all the exercises away, and no one felt wrong at all.
When we arrived at the third stone chamber, there was only a withered skeleton and a storage ring on the hand bone. This was a middle-grade storage ring.
Ye Chen opened it and took a look. There was a token from the Beast Control Sect and two jade slips.
"Hello, predestined one, I am Yang Jing, the young master of the Beast Controlling Sect in the Korean Empire. Because my father passed away due to illness, the sect fought for power, and other sects suppressed it, causing internal and external troubles. In the end, an elder named Zhao in the sect and the Seven Stars Sect collaborated to destroy our Beast Controlling Sect. I hope that the destined person can inherit our sect, avenge our sect, rebuild the sect, and spread our sect throughout the world."
After reading it, Ye Chen bowed deeply and read another rose jade slip, "The Art of Controlling Beasts"
In my previous life, I didn’t study beast control, but in this life I got the secret of beast control.
"The universe borrows the law, and all the demons listen to the orders. I use my will to drive your envoys, use the spirit to draw the seal, and use the spirit to melt it..."
The secret to controlling beasts is actually to use the soul to enter the seal, be driven by the soul, and finally add a blood contract to make the monster recognize its master.
Ye Chen buried the withered bones and bowed again. I want your inheritance. I will seek justice for you and carry forward your inheritance for generations to come. It’s just that the structure of the Beast Control Sect is too small, so we won’t rebuild it for you.
"Each of you take turns to memorize the beast control skills. You can give it a try when you meet a suitable monster in the future and find yourself a fighting partner." Ye Chen did not take it all to himself.
Yu Yuanyang smiled with satisfaction, "It has been almost a month since we all came out. We have been adjusting here for two days. This time, six of us came out and seven came back. Hahaha, we are all able to unite as one and not lose a single partner. Thank you very much! I hope you can practice more often in the future. There will be an auction at the Linglong Chamber of Commerce at the end of this month. If you are interested in participating, we will get together at the end of the month."
"Yuanyang, don't be so open-minded. From now on, we will be family, brothers and sisters who share life and death together."
Everyone laughed, chatted for a while, and then went to adjust their breath and practice. These days of life and death struggle really need to be adjusted well to avoid leaving hidden dangers.
Ye Chen took out 10 spiritual stones and set up a simple spirit gathering array, gathered his mind, held his breath and concentrated with his hands to make seals. In an instant, the spiritual energy gathered and became thicker and thicker. At the level where the spiritual energy was liquefied, the Chaos Beads also absorbed it crazily.
After two days of hard training, Ye Chen entered the ultimate realm, which is the tenth level of the Body Tempering Realm. Although he is stillHe has not entered the Qi Refining Realm, but Ye Chen's aura is strong at this time and he can already release his spiritual energy. From the beginning of the Qi Refining Realm, he can practice magic techniques to defend the enemy with Qi. He can use sword Qi to attack while practicing swordsmanship. Those with fire spirit roots can practice Spirit Fire Techniques and use Qi to control fire. They no longer simply rely on martial arts. The purity of the spiritual energy in the Dantian and the level of the Spiritual Techniques all affect combat effectiveness.
The Qi Refining Realm is where you really start to cultivate immortality, and the Body Tempering Realm is just to lay a solid foundation for your body.
Ye Chen took out the clothes he had prepared and dressed neatly, with a jade crown on his head, a jade belt tightly buckled around his waist, sword eyebrows and starry eyes, cloud and dragon pattern boots, a colorful glazed cloak, and a jade tree facing the wind, looking suave and graceful.
Liu Yanran's face was red at this moment, her heart was pounding, and she looked at Ye Chen shyly.
"Ye Chen, why don't you go to my house to propose marriage?" The voice was almost invisible. Ye Chen looked at her gently, "Yanran, I know your thoughts. We are still young. If you still like me after three years, I will marry you. This is a positive answer to Yanran."
In his previous life, Ye Chen only knew how to cultivate, rarely considered matters between men and women, and rejected many fairies. There is no longer rejection in this life, after all, it is a dimensionality reduction attack. After practicing hard in the past life, if you start again in this life, you will naturally get twice the result with half the effort.
The deeper Liu Yanran's love at this time, the deeper her hatred will be in the future. The word "love" can directly teach life and death to agree to each other, to have peace in the world, and to live up to Tathagata and live up to you.
Jade Yuanyang originally wanted to chat with Ye Chen. Although she just liked him, she also planted the seeds of love.
Jade Yuanyang is simple and cute, but also rational. She has the kind of temperament that takes everything lightly and takes everything lightly.
Seeing Liu Yanran accompanying Ye Chen, she didn't bother him or show any displeasure. This also caused the longest and most painful relationship between Yu Yuanyang. There are thousands of good medicines in the world, but none of them can cure lovesickness.
Everyone has finished practicing and their injuries have been healed. A group of boys and girls, wearing bright clothes and angry horses.
"Let's go! Go home" Jade Yuanyang said with a smile
"Go home!"
